Field notes: focused research organizations

Focused research organizations (FROs) are time-limited nonprofits that build one tool or dataset that neither academia nor startups would build alone. Convergent Research has incubated several, including E11 Bio and Cultivarium.

Critics argue that a five-to-seven year horizon is too short to build lasting institutions, and that FROs depend on a small pool of philanthropic funders.
